views.name: active_listing_details
views.definition:
SELECT vl.listing_id,
    v.vehicle_id,
    vl.asking_price,
    vl.description,
    vl.source_type,
    v.manufacturing_year,
    v.registration_year,
    v.kms_driven,
    v.colour,
    v.ownership_count,
    v.condition,
    m.manufacturer_name,
    vm.model_name,
    vm.body_type,
    vv.variant_name,
    vv.fuel_type,
    vv.transmission,
    dp.dealer_id,
    dp.dealership_name,
    c.city_id,
    c.city_name,
    estimate.estimated_price,
    estimate.lower_price,
    estimate.upper_price,
        CASE
            WHEN (estimate.estimated_price IS NULL) THEN 'estimate_unavailable'::text
            WHEN (vl.asking_price < COALESCE(estimate.lower_price, estimate.estimated_price)) THEN 'below_estimate_range'::text
            WHEN (vl.asking_price > COALESCE(estimate.upper_price, estimate.estimated_price)) THEN 'above_estimate_range'::text
            ELSE 'within_estimate_range'::text
        END AS estimate_comparison
   FROM (((((((app.vehicle_listings vl
     JOIN app.vehicles v ON ((v.vehicle_id = vl.vehicle_id)))
     JOIN app.vehicle_variants vv ON ((vv.variant_id = v.variant_id)))
     JOIN app.vehicle_models vm ON ((vm.model_id = vv.model_id)))
     JOIN app.manufacturers m ON ((m.manufacturer_id = vm.manufacturer_id)))
     JOIN app.dealer_profiles dp ON ((dp.dealer_id = v.dealer_id)))
     JOIN app.cities c ON ((c.city_id = dp.city_id)))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT lpe.estimated_price,
            lpe.lower_price,
            lpe.upper_price
           FROM app.listing_price_estimates lpe
          WHERE (lpe.listing_id = vl.listing_id)
          ORDER BY lpe.assessed_at DESC, lpe.estimate_id DESC
         LIMIT 1) estimate ON (true))
  WHERE ((vl.listing_status)::text = 'active'::text);

views.name: dealer_inventory_summary
views.definition:
SELECT dp.dealer_id,
    dp.dealership_name,
    c.city_name,
    count(vl.listing_id) FILTER (WHERE ((vl.listing_status)::text = 'active'::text)) AS active_listing_count,
    COALESCE(sum(vl.asking_price) FILTER (WHERE ((vl.listing_status)::text = 'active'::text)), (0)::numeric) AS active_asking_price_total,
    round(avg(vl.asking_price) FILTER (WHERE ((vl.listing_status)::text = 'active'::text)), 2) AS active_average_asking_price
   FROM (((app.dealer_profiles dp
     JOIN app.cities c ON ((c.city_id = dp.city_id)))
     LEFT JOIN app.vehicles v ON ((v.dealer_id = dp.dealer_id)))
     LEFT JOIN app.vehicle_listings vl ON ((vl.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id)))
  GROUP BY dp.dealer_id, dp.dealership_name, c.city_name;
